content.comment_body: Hello, is it possible for [product_name] Web Editor to show a word value that includes a comma or decimal point? Thanks.
This is not possible using the default software provided by [company_name]. If you know HTML5, you might be able to achieve this on your own.

analysis.insight_summary: The conversation centers on the limitation of [company_name]'s software for [product_name] Web Editor, which does not allow numerical values to be displayed with commas or decimal points. Users highlight that anyone needing this feature may have to use additional skills beyond the standard tools.
